summary: Supplement Plan Feature Testing Complete - Backend: 21/21 tests passed (100%), Frontend: All critical features verified. The 8-week supplement plan generator works correctly with stack, schedule, phases, warnings, and LLM-generated personal summary. Admin panel Supplements tab loads all 17 supplements with edit/toggle functionality.

issues: These are React Native Web deprecation warnings, non-blocking

critical_code_review_comments: Backend supplement plan APIs properly handle plan generation, retrieval, reminders, and admin supplement management
All 17 supplements in SUPPLEMENT_DB have correct structure with German/Italian names, dosages, timing, evidence levels, synergies, antagonists, contraindications, and medication interactions

Plan generation logic correctly: adds Ashwagandha for high stress (stress_level >= 7), adds Vitamin K2 synergy when Vitamin D is present (unless on blood thinners), excludes contraindicated supplements with warnings
Frontend supplement-plan.tsx correctly displays 3 tabs (Supplement-Stack, Tagesplan, Wochenplan) with expandable supplement cards
LLM personal summary generation works via emergentintegrations with graceful fallback to static summary
Admin panel Supplements tab shows all 17 supplements with edit/toggle functionality
seed_data_creation: Multiple health profiles created during backend testing (vegan, high-stress, hashimoto conditions) to verify plan generation logic
context_for_next_testing_agent: SUPPLEMENT PLAN FEATURE FULLY FUNCTIONAL. Test profile ID: 2416f8aa-09aa-47f1-b600-2c9ada87124d (vegan, high stress, diabetes, metformin, fatigue, hair_loss). APIs tested: POST /api/supplement-plan/{profile_id}?lang=de (generates plan), GET /api/supplement-plan/{profile_id} (retrieves plan), GET /api/supplement-plan/{profile_id}/week/{week_num} (week-specific data), PUT /api/supplement-plan/{profile_id}/reminders (update reminders), GET /api/supplement-plan/{profile_id}/reminders (get reminders), GET /api/admin/supplements (lists all 17 supplements), PUT /api/admin/supplements/{id} (update supplement). Frontend: Direct navigation to /supplement-plan?profileId={id} works. Onboarding flow works but requires completing all 6 steps before reaching assessment results page with 'Supplement-Plan erstellen' button.

backend_supplement_plan_generation.details: POST /api/supplement-plan/{profile_id}?lang=de generates plan with stack, schedule, phases, warnings, personal_summary

backend_plan_retrieval.details: GET /api/supplement-plan/{profile_id} returns full plan with all required fields

backend_week_plan.details: GET /api/supplement-plan/{profile_id}/week/{week_num} returns week-specific phase and schedule data

backend_reminders.details: PUT and GET /api/supplement-plan/{profile_id}/reminders work correctly for enabling/disabling reminders with time settings

backend_admin_supplements.details: GET /api/admin/supplements lists all 17 supplements with correct structure, PUT updates work for dosage/timing/active status

business_logic_vegan_b12.details: Vegan diet profiles get B12 recommendation based on deficiency scoring

business_logic_high_stress_ashwagandha.details: High stress (>=7) profiles get Ashwagandha unless contraindicated by hashimoto/hypothyroidism

business_logic_vitamin_d_k2_synergy.details: Vitamin D in plan automatically adds Vitamin K2 synergy unless patient is on blood thinners

business_logic_contraindications.details: Contraindicated supplements (e.g., Ashwagandha/Iodine with hashimoto) are excluded with warnings

frontend_supplement_plan_page.details: Direct navigation to /supplement-plan?profileId={id} loads plan with title 'Ihr Mikronaehrstoff-Plan', personal summary, 3 tabs

frontend_stack_tab.details: Shows all supplements as expandable cards with name, dosage, timing, reason, evidence, side effects

frontend_schedule_tab.details: Shows Morgens/Abends sections with supplement lists and dosages

frontend_phases_tab.details: Shows 4 phases (Woche 1-2, 3-4, 5-6, 7-8) with titles, descriptions, and notes

admin_supplements_tab.details: Admin panel Supplements tab loads all 17 supplements in table with ID, Name (DE/IT), Kategorie, Dosierung, Timing, Evidenz, Aktiv status, and Edit/Toggle buttons

onboarding_wizard.details: 6-step onboarding wizard works: Basisdaten, Lebensstil, Stress & Energie, Gesundheit, Beschwerden, Labor
